name: MTRONIC
recent: MTRONIC 近期发布了截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止财务期的合并业绩，并多次发布「OTHERS」公告。公司因触发上市规则第 8.03A 条，持续按月发布公告。此外，公司因员工认股权计划（ESOS）行使而发行了 2.205 亿股新股，新股于 2026 年 10 月 14 日上市。
notable: 公司因员工认股权计划（ESOS）行使而发行 220,523,100 股新股，发行价为每股 RM0.0045。
公司发布了截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止财务期的合并业绩。
risks: 公司因触发上市规则第 8.03A 条，需按月发布公告，该规则通常涉及财务困境或营运水平不足。
ESOS 行使导致新股发行，现有股东持股可能被摊薄。

ann.title: Consolidated results for the financial period ended 31/07/2026

recent_en: MTRONIC recently released its consolidated results for the financial period ended 31 July 2026 and issued several 'OTHERS' announcements. The company continues to make monthly announcements as it triggers Paragraph/Rule 8.03A of the listing requirements. In addition, it issued 220.5 million new shares under its Employees Share Option Scheme (ESOS), which were listed on 14 October 2026.
notable_en: The company issued 220,523,100 new shares under its Employees Share Option Scheme (ESOS) at an issue price of RM0.0045 per share.
The company released its consolidated results for the financial period ended 31 July 2026.
risks_en: The company is required to make monthly announcements under Paragraph/Rule 8.03A, which typically relates to financial distress or insufficient level of operations.
The exercise of ESOS options resulted in the issuance of new shares, which may dilute existing shareholders' holdings.
